newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends lower, liquidation hits May.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends lower, liquidation hits May.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended lower on Friday, led by the May contract on spreading and liquidation ahead of first notice day Wednesday, traders said.
"Most of the volume today was in July/May spreads," a floor sources said. "They're getting out of the May."

The open interest in the May as of Thursday's close was at 1,209 contracts, down 34 from the previous day, CBOT reported. Floor sources said they expected light deliveries to be posted against the May.
LFG, Dean Witter and LIT America were said to be getting out of the May contract, floor sources said.
Rice ended three to one cent per cwt lower with May off three at $11.50.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 700 lots, compared with Thursday's actual volume of 327 lots.
